name: Feishu MCP Server
description: A remote Model Context Protocol server for Feishu (Lark) that supports OAuth authentication and deployment on Cloudflare Workers. It allows AI clients to interact with Feishu documents, perform content searches, and manage document blocks with a zero-configuration experience.
